what: Eversource Energy delivers electricity, natural gas and water across Connecticut, Massachusetts and New Hampshire. It is a pure delivery utility with no generation after exiting its offshore wind investments.
customers: About 4.4 million electricity, gas and water customers across three New England states.
money: gas distribution and the Aquarion water utility
moat: Delivery monopolies across New England with returns set by state regulators, in a region with no practical alternative supplier.
risks: Exiting offshore wind cost it billions in write-downs
Connecticut regulators have been among the toughest in the country on allowed returns
opportunities: Selling the water business would raise cash to reduce debt
watch: Connecticut regulatory decisions and the pace of debt reduction.
